arabic text: HAYE HAYE QASIM HAYE QASIM\nO’ QASIM! O’QASIM
KABHI IS TUKDE PER HAYE QASIM\nKABHI US TUKDE PER HAYE QASIM
english translation text: SAYING O’ QASIM O’ QASIM\nSHE (ZAINAB) WOULD LAMENT ON THE BROKEN BODY OF QASIM

arabic text: KABHI LASHA DEKH KE ROTI THI, KABHI GHASH KHAAKE GIRJAATI THI\nPAMAAL HUWA THA BHAI JAHAAN, US KHOON PE GHIR KAR HAYE QASIM
english translation text:
SOMETIMES SHE WOULD WEEP LOOKING AT HIS BODY
SOMETIMES SHE WOULD LOSE CONSCIOUSNESS
THE PLACE WHERE HER BROTHER’S BODY HAD BEEN TRAMPLED
ON THAT PLACE SHE WOULD CRY O’ QASIM

arabic text: FARWA NE KAHA BETA QASIM, KEHDENA DAADI ZAHRA SE\nGHURBAT KI KAMAAI TUKDO ME, DETI HAI SAJAA KAR HAYE QASIM
english translation text:
FARWA SAID O’ MY SON QASIM
TELL YOUR GRANDMOTHER ZAHRA
HERE IS MY SACRIFICE IN PIECES...
...I PRESENT THIS TO YOU (AND SHE WOULD CRY) O’ QASIM
